//: Hand-collected FY26Q2 (Jan-Mar 2026) values, taken from the dashboard as filled in at the time. Used by `pnpm collect --quarter FY26Q2 --compare config/known-good/FY26Q2.json` to check this tool against a quarter a human already did.
//1: Dates were given in US M/D/YYYY in the sheet and are normalised to ISO here.
//2: 'Not versioned' is what the sheet records for the website; the tool reports those as unavailable rather than inventing a string.
//3: TWO ENTRIES DEPART FROM THE SHEET, both resolved 2026-07-28. Bloom Editor's latest release: the sheet says 6.2.8 / 2026-04-06, which is AFTER this quarter ended; we report the last release inside the period, so 6.2.7 / 2026-03-16 is the expectation here and the sheet's entry is treated as a mistake.
//6: Bloom Reader's installs expectation is 1573, NOT the 2434 originally recorded on the sheet. The dashboard defines Installs as 'Unique first-run', and 2434 came from Play Console's events-based 'All device acquisitions' metric, which counts re-installs. The uniques-based metric Google calls 'Device acquisition > New devices' reads 482 + 486 + 602 = 1570 for these months, matching the bulk report column Daily Device Installs (1573) within the tolerance. The same error affects the 2193 recorded for FY26Q1.
//5: Number of User Countries is expected to differ slightly. We count distinct mp_country_code on events; the ad-hoc report used for the sheet counted $country_code on people profiles -- last-known country per user rather than country at event time. Bloom Editor's 108 vs 104 is that difference and is expected to be flagged; the others are within event-timing drift.
//4: Bloom Reader's user metrics are recorded here as this tool computes them, not as the sheet had them (activeUsers 4452, avgMau 2154, MAU 2256/2149/2057). The sheet's figures were NOT wrong -- they were correct when collected. The gap is late-arriving events: it scales with how recent the month is (Jan +10.6%, Feb +15.3%, Mar +21.6%) and affects only Bloom Reader, the offline-first Android app, whose events upload when a device next has connectivity. Bloom Editor, Bloom Library and BloomPUB Viewer all matched the sheet exactly. The drift is still measurable: across three runs in one afternoon, Bloom Reader's activeUsers went 5435 -> 5437 -> 5453 for FY26Q3. So a quarter collected soon after it ends will read lower than the same quarter collected months later, and comparability depends on collecting at a consistent lag.
